content.value: A hardware engineer is asked to design a sequence detector. The detector will examine a (14) string of 0's and 1's applied to the x input and generate an output z = 1 only when a prescribed input sequence occurs. The detector circuit needs to be designed so that any input sequence ending in 101 will produce an output z = 1. coincided with last 1. The circuit does not reset when a 1 output occurs.
